Formal bill schedule for the community facilities

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM04 Date 2026-04-09 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

Use the following complete formal Bill schedule of seven rows. BQ and SOR have separate number series, so BQ Bill 1 and SOR Bill 1 are distinct identities. The final words in parentheses in BQ Bill 5 are part of its formal description. The schedules have no eighth Bill.

Pricing type | Bill No. | Formal description
BQ | 1 | Preliminaries
BQ | 2 | Preambles
BQ | 3 | Piled Foundations and Shallow Footings
BQ | 4 | Community Hall and Library Structure
BQ | 5 | Community Hall Finishes (All Provisional)
SOR | 1 | Ventilation Plant and Ductwork
SOR | 2 | Passenger Lifts and Escalators

The summary and collection sheets are support pages for these seven Bills. They do not create additional Bills or alter the formal descriptions above.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Foundation design and submission requirements

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM07 Date 2026-04-14 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

The complete component responsibility schedule is:
Component | Actual work scope | Contractor designs | Contractor executes
piling | Bored piles for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | Pile caps for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
footings | Shallow footings for the sports building and entrance canopy | Yes | Yes
other | Architect designed internal partitions | No | Yes

The shallow footings serve the sports building and the main entrance canopy, which is a major external structure. Treat footings as serving buildings or major external structures.

The foundation design will not be established at tender acceptance. The Contractor must submit its proposed foundation design with the Tender for assessment; subsequent checking and approval do not mean that the final design is already established at tender acceptance.

RSE endorsed submissions are required. The additional submission requirements are:
Submit a construction noise management proposal with the Tender.
Submit a traffic diversion method statement with the Tender.

Should the special requirement to obtain a design-related quotation before instructing a Variation be adopted? This reply contains no adopted decision on that requirement. Keep the matter open for the business reviewer.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

For SCT7, the Project Architect post is Senior Architect Community Projects. Use the professional title Dr rather than Mr or Ms. The appointed fictional officer's name is Julian K. M. LEE.

What telephone number is to be published for the Project Architect? No telephone number has been confirmed. Contact the fictional coordination mailbox architect@consense-scenario.invalid meanwhile; this mailbox is not a telephone number.

The Specification Library is available for inspection at floor 3, Block C, Fictional Civic Project Office, 88 Learning Road, Tin Shui Wai.

The actual site visit restrictions are:
Apply in writing at least ten working days before the proposed visit.
Each visiting group is limited to six persons and must wear safety helmets and protective footwear.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

decisions.rawValue: 1. Changing room shower floors and kerbs, including the recessed accessible shower bays, waterproofed bench supports and pipe penetrations. Turn the membrane up behind the wall lining, seal the interfaces with the floor drains and continue the protection beneath the entrance thresholds; 2. Library archive basement retaining walls, including wall to slab junctions, construction joints and service sleeves. The tanking must extend around the recessed book delivery entrance and terminate at the approved external ground level, with compatible seals where the wall meets the loading apron; 3. Sports hall equipment wash bays and their trapped drains, including cleaning cupboard floors and the wash down channels. Provide continuous waterproofing beneath equipment plinths and around the floor gully collars, and protect the membrane where maintenance trolleys pass between the wet bay and storage room; 4. Community hall catering preparation sinks, service trenches and splashback upstands, including the dishwashing recess and the small refrigerated store. Continue waterproofing through the trench junctions and under the counter legs, with sealed access covers and membrane returns at every wet area door; 5. Rainwater harvesting tank external faces, inspection sumps and connecting channels, including the tank base joints, pipe connection chambers and overflow route to the landscape drain; Include the waterproofed junctions at maintenance access openings and ensure that the protection boards do not obstruct the inspection or replacement of the access seals; 6. Courtyard fountain basin, overflow chamber and adjacent service duct, including the fountain pump recess and the cable entry sleeves. Waterproof the full basin wall and floor surfaces beneath the finishes, return the system over the perimeter edge and seal the movement joints separating the basin from the paved courtyard; 7. Loading bay ramps over the underground library store and associated movement joints, including the wheel guide plinths and drainage channel at the ramp foot. The waterproofing must continue behind the kerbs and around the store ventilation openings, with a traffic compatible wearing layer over all vehicle routes; 8. Caretaker block laundry balconies and clothes drying platforms, including the recessed washing machine positions and the shared laundry entrance; Include membrane returns around thresholds and drainage outlets, seal balustrade post fixings and continue the waterproofed surface beneath the removable service platforms used to maintain the washing machine supply pipes; 9. Green roof planting troughs over the community hall foyer and their perimeter upstands, including the irrigation valve pockets and emergency overflow outlets. The waterproofing must include compatible root resistant protection, continuous seals at trough corners and accessible inspection zones around every drain outlet.
